facts.text: The ONU ZERO Tuition program covers the cost of tuition for up to four years for qualifying undergraduate students at Olivet Nazarene University.

sources.title: Zero Tuition - Olivet Nazarene University
sources.quote: The ONU ZERO Tuition covers the cost of tuition for up to four (4) years (up to 8 full-time consecutive fall and spring semesters of 12-18 credits) at Olivet Nazarene University for qualifying students.
